Interface GameView

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChessFrame
public interface GameView
What the GameController needs from the window.

The controller talks to the window only through this interface, so it does not depend on any particular Swing layout, and a test could supply a fake view. ChessFrame is the real implementation.
